title: I Built an AI Powered Finance Terminal with Qwen3.8-27B
author: Agreeable-Project571
selftext:
Hello, with Claude I built a FULL finance terminal with real market data for equities, FX, crypto, and indices, historical data, insider transactions, news, and SEC documents. On every page of the site, it’s possible to call the AI, which is powered by the new Qwen3.8 model and reads all that information. It’s also possible to ask the AI anything on the dedicated page.

To run the AI, I’m using Vast for $90/month. Do you think this will have any future? 🥲

PS. Also, just for me, I’m running the same model with the same data for trading using a broker API, but I won’t share any results yet because it’s only been running for a few days.  
Let me know in the comments what you guys think!

comments.author: BryanTaven
comments.body: What makes this different from anything already out there?

replies.author: Agreeable-Project571
replies.body: **Does it really have to be different?**

replies.author: Agreeable-Project571
replies.body: I think most things are pretty similar nowadays. I just tried to put as many useful things as possible in one place, indicators, charts, data, integrations, a clean UI, etc. Nothing revolutionary, just fun for me
